module UI.Alert exposing (..)

import Html exposing (..)
import Html.Attributes as Attr
import Http exposing (Error(..))
import Svg exposing (path, svg)
import Svg.Attributes as SvgAttr
import UI.Common exposing (role)


type Variant
    = Destructive
    | Default


base : String
base =
    """relative w-full rounded-lg border 
px-4 py-3 text-sm grid has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] grid-cols-[0_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 items-start 
[&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&>svg]:text-current"""


data_slot : String -> Attribute msg
data_slot slot =
    Attr.attribute "data-slot" slot


alert : { a | variant : Variant } -> List (Attribute msg) -> List (Html msg) -> Html msg
alert config attrs children =
    case config.variant of
        Default ->
            div
                (attrs
                    ++ [ role "alert"
                       , data_slot "alert"
                       , Attr.classList
                            [ ( "bg-card text-card-foreground *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-muted-foreground", True )
                            , ( base, True )
                            ]
                       ]
                )
                children

        Destructive ->
            div
                (attrs
                    ++ [ role "alert"
                       , Attr.classList
                            [ ( "[&>svg]:text-destructive border-destructive/50 dark:border-destructive text-destructive bg-card [&>svg]:text-current *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90", True )
                            , ( base, True )
                            ]
                       ]
                )
                children


alert_title : List (Attribute msg) -> List (Html msg) -> Html msg
alert_title attrs children =
    h5
        (attrs
            ++ [ data_slot "alert-title"
               , Attr.class "col-start-2 line-clamp-1 min-h-4 font-medium tracking-tight"
               ]
        )
        children


alert_description : List (Attribute msg) -> List (Html msg) -> Html msg
alert_description attrs children =
    div
        (attrs
            ++ [ data_slot "alert-description"
               , Attr.class " col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed"
               ]
        )
        children


error_alert : String -> Html msg -> Html msg
error_alert msg_type children =
    div
        [ Attr.class "flex items-center p-4 mb-4 text-sm text-red-800 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400"
        , Attr.attribute "role" "alert"
        ]
        [ svg
            [ SvgAttr.class "flex-shrink-0 inline w-4 h-4 me-3"
            , Attr.attribute "aria-hidden" "true"
            , SvgAttr.fill "currentColor"
            , SvgAttr.viewBox "0 0 20 20"
            ]
            [ path
                [ SvgAttr.d "M10 .5a9.5 9.5 0 1 0 9.5 9.5A9.51 9.51 0 0 0 10 .5ZM9.5 4a1.5 1.5 0 1 1 0 3 1.5 1.5 0 0 1 0-3ZM12 15H8a1 1 0 0 1 0-2h1v-3H8a1 1 0 0 1 0-2h2a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v4h1a1 1 0 0 1 0 2Z"
                ]
                []
            ]
        , span
            [ Attr.class "sr-only"
            ]
            [ text "Info" ]
        , div []
            [ span
                [ Attr.class "font-medium"
                ]
                [ text <| msg_type ++ " " ]
            , children
            ]
        ]


http_error_alert : String -> Http.Error -> Html msg
http_error_alert request_for e =
    case e of
        Http.BadUrl _ ->
            error_alert request_for (span [] [ text "Bad url passed into http message." ])

        Http.Timeout ->
            error_alert request_for (span [] [ text "The Http request timed out." ])

        Http.NetworkError ->
            error_alert request_for (span [] [ text "Network request could not be processed." ])

        Http.BadStatus status ->
            error_alert request_for (span [] [ text <| "Server responded with a " ++ String.fromInt status ++ "." ])

        Http.BadBody err_msg ->
            error_alert request_for (span [] [ text err_msg ])
